appearance_facts.fact: Six blue circular markers form a tight, steep upward diagonal; each higher marker sits further right than the one below it.
The highest and rightmost point, positioned near the top edge of the plot area.
The lowest and leftmost point, sitting near the origin at the bottom of the plot.
Each marker has a small text label above it reading 'Week N' for N = 2 through 6; the bottom-left marker has no visible label.
